address: 5/2 Tonpo Road, Talat, Mueang Surat Thani, Surat Thani, 84000, Thailand
bio: Consummately crafted regional specialties are the highlight here, particularly long tong, a Surat Thani delicacy. It features succulent dry noodles in a pink sweet and sour sauce with tender portions of pig’s blood, skin and meat. Leave room for the delectable mango with sticky rice....
